introductionText.p1: When I trained in the Renata França method in 2023, I first practiced in the physical therapy clinics where I was working.
introductionText.p2: But I quickly felt out of place. I was offering premium wellness treatments in a place that was inherently medical, noisy, and impersonal. It was the opposite of my vision.
introductionText.p3: I wanted to offer something intimate and cosy, an escape of relaxation and serenity in a busy life.
introductionText.p4: That's how Lyvi was born, from the desire to combine the immediate effects of Renata treatments with my skills as a physical therapist, in an elegant and soothing setting.
introductionText.pilars: Lyvi is based on four pillars: helping you achieve your goals, making each session an exceptional moment focused on you, providing you with professional support rooted in my expertise as a high-level sports physiotherapist, and offering a treatment experience that reflects who I am.

objectivesText.title: MY GOAL: TO HELP YOU ACHIEVE YOURS
objectivesText.p1: Whatever your long-term goal, each session begins with a moment of listening and discussion to define your goal for the day based on how you feel, what you want, and your energy level.
objectivesText.p2: I then tailor the treatment to best suit your current needs, always promising that you will leave feeling energized, radiant, and filled with a sense of lightness.
objectivesText.p3: The results are visible, you feel that something has already been set in motion in your body, and you reach your final goal gently and smoothly.

youMatterText.title: MAKE YOU THE CENTER OF THE WORLD, FOR A MOMENT
youMatterText.p1: Beyond personalized care, Lyvi is an experience in itself, centered around you.
youMatterText.p2: Everything has been thoughtfully designed to make you feel at home. I welcome you with a smile, in French, German, or English, so that language is never a barrier.
youMatterText.p3: The space is warm, cozy, intimate, and comforting—what Germans sum up in a single word: gemütlich.
youMatterText.p4: Every one of your needs is anticipated, everything flows seamlessly to make this moment truly unique.

physioText.title: RENATA TREATMENTS WITH THE EXPERTISE OF YOUR PHYSICAL THERAPIST
physioText.p1: I have always been passionate about motorsports. My childhood dream was to work at Porsche. And in my little girl's mind, joining them meant I had to know how to speak German. So that's why I started learning it on my own at the age of 8. 😅
physioText.p2: Today, I don't (yet) work at Porsche, but being fluent in German has opened other doors for me, including into high-level sports.
physioText.p3: Among other things, I was a physical therapist for the German men's artistic gymnastics national team in Berlin for several years. I had the opportunity to work with athletes, some of whom went on to become world champions or Olympic silver medalists.
physioText.p4: Working in high-performance sports requires you to be effective no matter what. It is this heightened efficiency and body expertise that I bring to Renata treatments, both in the precision of my movements and in the advice I give.

likeMeText.title: AN EXPERIENCE THAT REFLECTS WHO I AM
likeMeText.p1: Lyvi is ultimately a reflection of my identity: professional care provided in a relaxed atmosphere where simplicity is key.
likeMeText.p2BeforeLiv: The name Lyvi is inspired by the Scandinavian word
likeMeText.p2AfterLiv: , which means "life" — life as I see it: in motion, made up of encounters and projects, laughter and lightness, which I hope to communicate to you.
likeMeText.p3: Be yourself, it's the best way to feel comfortable and have a good time.
likeMeText.p4: I'm looking forward to welcoming you.
